tile.name: Flashing tools
tile.desc: Firmware onto radios and boards, from a browser

menu.title: Flashing tools
menu.subtitle: Put firmware onto radios and boards over USB, from Chrome or Edge on a computer.
menu.about: The web flasher for ESP32 radios, FreeOCD for ARM chips through a debug probe, and the serial terminal to watch them start. Each needs the box's HTTPS address (Web Serial and WebUSB work only there).
